sk.AttachmentSupport = [(xy, '')]
sk.MapMode = 'FlatFace'

# Create rectangle: 12 x 8 mm, corner at origin
# Four line segments: from (0,0) to (12,0), (12,0) to (12,8), (12,8) to (0,8), (0,8) to (0,0)
sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(0, 0, 0), FreeCAD.Vector(12, 0, 0)), False)
sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(12, 0, 0), FreeCAD.Vector(12, 8, 0)), False)

sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(0, 8, 0), FreeCAD.Vector(0, 0, 0)), False)

# Connect endpoints (coincident constraints)
for i in range(4):
    sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Coincident', i, 2, (i + 1) % 4, 1))

# Make lines horizontal/vertical
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Horizontal', 0))
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Horizontal', 2))
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Vertical', 1))
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Vertical', 3))

# Fix corner at origin (geometry -1, point 1 is the origin)
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Coincident', 0, 1, -1, 1))

# Set dimensions: width 12 mm, height 8 mm
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('DistanceX', 0, 1, 0, 2, 12.0))
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('DistanceY', 1, 1, 1, 2, 8.0))

pad = body.newObject('PartDesign::Pad', 'Pad')
pad.Profile = sk
pad.Length = 20

import FreeCAD
import Part
import Sketcher

doc = FreeCAD.newDocument("T")

# Create Body
body = doc.addObject('PartDesign::Body', 'Body')
xy = body.Origin.OriginFeatures[3]  # XY_Plane

# Create sketch on XY plane
sk = body.newObject('Sketcher::SketchObject', 'Sketch')
sk.AttachmentSupport = [(xy, '')]
sk.MapMode = 'FlatFace'

# Add 10x10 mm square with corner at origin
sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(0,0,0), FreeCAD.Vector(10,0,0)), False)
sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(10,0,0), FreeCAD.Vector(10,10,0)), False)
sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(10,10,0), FreeCAD.Vector(0,10,0)), False)
sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(0,10,0), FreeCAD.Vector(0,0,0)), False)

# Coincident constraints for closed loop
for i in range(4):
    sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Coincident', i, 2, (i+1) % 4, 1))

# Horizontal/vertical constraints
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Horizontal', 0))
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Horizontal', 2))
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Vertical', 1))
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Vertical', 3))

# Fix corner at origin
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Coincident', 0, 1, -1, 1))

# Set dimensions
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('DistanceX', 0, 1, 0, 2, 10.0))
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('DistanceY', 1, 1, 1, 2, 10.0))

doc.recompute()

# Pad 5 mm
pad = body.newObject('PartDesign::Pad', 'Pad')
pad.Profile = sk
pad.Length = 5
doc.recompute()

# LinearPattern along sketch H_Axis, Length=40, Occurrences=3
pattern = body.newObject('PartDesign::LinearPattern', 'Pattern')
pattern.Originals = [pad]
pattern.Direction = (sk, ['H_Axis'])
pattern.Length = 40
pattern.Occurrences = 3
body.Tip = pattern
doc.recompute()

xy = body.Origin.OriginFeatures[3]

# Create sketch on XY plane
sk = body.newObject('Sketcher::SketchObject', 'Sketch')
sk.AttachmentSupport = [(xy, '')]
sk.MapMode = 'FlatFace'

# 10x10 mm square with corner at origin
sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(0, 0, 0), FreeCAD.Vector(10, 0, 0)), False)
sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(10, 0, 0), FreeCAD.Vector(10, 10, 0)), False)
sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(10, 10, 0), FreeCAD.Vector(0, 10, 0)), False)
sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(0, 10, 0), FreeCAD.Vector(0, 0, 0)), False)

# Connect endpoints
for i in range(4):
    sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Coincident', i, 2, (i + 1) % 4, 1))

# Keep lines axis-aligned
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Horizontal', 0))
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Horizontal', 2))
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Vertical', 1))
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Vertical', 3))

# Fix corner at origin
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Coincident', 0, 1, -1, 1))

# Set dimensions
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('DistanceX', 0, 1, 0, 2, 10.0))
sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('DistanceY', 1, 1, 1, 2, 10.0))

doc.recompute()

# Pad 5 mm
pad = body.newObject('PartDesign::Pad', 'Pad')
pad.Profile = sk
pad.Length = 5
doc.recompute()

# LinearPattern along sketch H_Axis, Length=40, Occurrences=3
pattern = body.newObject('PartDesign::LinearPattern', 'Pattern')
pattern.Originals = [pad]
pattern.Direction = (sk, ['H_Axis'])
pattern.Length = 40
pattern.Occurrences = 3
body.Tip = pattern
doc.recompute()
